prompts.name: cast_thread
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy Phaser VFX texture for Asterveil Fateweave Bolt Astral Thread. 4-frame flipbook arranged in exactly 2 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells. Each cell centered on same staff-tip anchor (no staff). Thin violet and sky-white curved gathering threads and tapered petals curl inward from sparse to concentrated, no complete circles. Four sequential frames. Transparent background, effect-only RGBA. Clean intentional tapered shapes, delicate anime painted luminous filaments, crisp tiny white core and colored violet edges, low soft glow. Keep all art isolated inside respective cells with broad fully transparent margins; no separators. No text, labels, UI, characters, scenery, weapons, props, watermark, background, full-screen flash. Palette #F3FBFF #BCEBFF #C5A4FF #8661D9. Do not render a checkerboard.
